name: query-builder
title: Query Builder
description: A visual filter composer where each row picks a field, an operator and a value, joined by And or Or. Add rule grows the list, Add group nests an indented subgroup, and each row can be removed.
use: Users must combine several filters with AND/OR logic and see the rule structure while building it.
avoid: It is a set of parts needing a fields schema and controlled query state, not a drop-in search box.
a11y: Fields, operators and values carry labels and the rules expose list roles; no reduced-motion check exists, though little moves. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark form on black: a small Where label followed by rows of rounded outlined dropdowns and an input, each row ending in a bin icon, with a thin And selector at the left of later rows. Below the rows sit quiet Add rule and Add group links.
behaves: Choosing a field swaps the operator list and the value control to match it, so a date field gets a date picker and Status gets a short list. Add rule appends a row and Add group nests an indented subgroup; the small And or Or select changes how rows combine.
customise: Pass a fields schema and a controlled query value, then arrange the rows from the exported parts; labels, maxDepth and disabled are props. The order and layout of the controls are yours.
weight: light: A handful of dropdowns and popovers with nothing animating at rest.
